episode_summary: In this episode, Austin Clarence discusses the introduction of the Vantage Score for mortgage approvals, offering a modern alternative to the traditional FICO score. He also highlights new opportunities for self-employed borrowers through profit and loss loans and explores the current interest rate trends. Additionally, the episode provides strategies for young buyers to build credit and emphasizes the potential in targeting older home buyers who are experiencing life changes.
